$meta.name: GeoTech-Sigmoid Annotation Tokens
$meta.description: Design tokens for the vineyard geo-annotation platform (view / correct / verify / export over 311 GeoTIFF tiles). Import directly into the React + Leaflet frontend. Overlay colors follow Marcaj preview convention: bright saturated strokes + subtle low-opacity fills + a thin dark halo for legibility over aerial imagery.
$meta.usage: import tokens from '@/design/design-tokens.json'. Reference nested groups, e.g. tokens.overlay.rows.stroke.
$meta.theme: dark-first (primary theme for an imagery tool); light theme included as secondary

overlay._doc: Class overlay colors. Each class: stroke (bright saturated, drawn ON TOP), halo (thin dark outline drawn UNDER the stroke for contrast on bright imagery), fill (rgba low-alpha), strokeWidth (px at native zoom). Render order per polygon: halo path (haloWidth) -> fill -> stroke. haloWidth = strokeWidth + 2.

halo._doc: Shared dark halo under every overlay stroke. Draw the same geometry once at strokeWidth+widthOffset in this color, then the colored stroke on top.

interRowMixed._treatment: Chosen: amber hue + dashed stroke. A differentiated hue (amber, not cyan) plus a dash pattern makes 'mixed' unmistakable next to bare_soil (solid cyan) even at a glance and for color-vision-deficient users. Both signal (hue + pattern) redundantly.

status._doc: Verification-status colors for tile badges + navigator cells.

color._doc: Neutral UI palette. dark = primary theme, light = secondary. WCAG AA checked for text pairs.

semantic._doc: Interactive-state accents. Values are theme-independent brand accents; pair with color.* backgrounds.

vertex._doc: Polygon editor handle states. radius in CSS px, unaffected by map zoom.

edge._doc: Active/highlighted edge segment when hovered for split/drag.

midpointAdd._doc: Ghost handle shown at edge midpoints; click to insert a vertex.

spacing._doc: 8px base scale with a 4px half-step. Use these keys; no ad-hoc values.

typography._doc: System + monospace mix for a dense functional tool. Monospace for tile IDs / coordinates / counts; sans for UI chrome.

fontFamily.sans: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
fontFamily.mono: 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', 'Roboto Mono', Menlo, Consolas, monospace

zoom._doc: Leaflet Simple/pixel CRS guidance for 2048x2048 tiles.

contrast._doc: WCAG AA verification for the dark (primary) theme. Ratios approximate.
contrast.overlay_strokes: bright saturated over aerial imagery; dark halo guarantees >=3:1 edge contrast regardless of background
